steps.name: watch-fingerprint-and-notify
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_soak_watch.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_soak_watch.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 7
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/

steps.name: watch-freshness-and-state
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_soak_watch.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/scripts/test_soak_watch.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 12
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/scripts/
